text: Mid course test, Track 1 Okay, today I want you to tell the class about your family at home. Marius, do you have a brother or sister? Yes, I have a brother. He's 14 and he loves football and basketball and he goes to the gym on Saturday mornings with our father. They both love exercise, but I don't. I like to play computer games. Yes, we know you do. What about you, Clara? I have a big sister and a little brother. My sister Katja likes school. She does her homework after school and then she reads books about science. She wants to study science at university. My brother is 5 years old and watches TV every evening after school. Sophia, do you have a brother? No, I have one sister, Rosa. She's 23 and lives in Mexico with my grandparents. She's at university in Mexico City. Rosa wants to be a doctor and work in a hospital. She goes online and chats to my mother every evening, but she's very busy, so they don't chat for a long time. And Jason, what about your family? My parents live in Beijing in China. My father is a chef and he works in a restaurant in the city centre. My mother is a schoolteacher. They are both very busy, but my mother texts me every day. Do you have any brothers or sisters, Jason? No, I don't.
